$description: Approved public semantic foundation for the Product Character direction.

default.$description: The application background behind default surfaces and page content.
The default bounded surface placed above the application canvas.

primary.$description: Primary copy, labels, and high-emphasis interface text on the application canvas.

muted.$description: Secondary copy, metadata, and helper text on the application canvas.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis separators and nonessential boundaries; never the only state indicator.

background.$description: Fill for the primary action on a surface.

foreground.$description: Text and icon color placed on the primary action fill.

accent.$description: Brand accent for selected or emphasized non-text signal marks on the canvas.

highlight.$description: High-attention non-text highlight on the canvas.

danger.$description: Destructive and error signal marks on the canvas.

1.$description: First categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

2.$description: Second categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

3.$description: Third categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

4.$description: Fourth categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

5.$description: Fifth categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

6.$description: Sixth categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

7.$description: Seventh categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

8.$description: Eighth categorical data-series slot in the fixed color-vision-deficiency-safe sequence.

other.$description: Low-chroma slot for categorical series folded into the visible Other group.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator on the application canvas.

0.$description: Removes structural separation without introducing a magic value.

1.$description: Tight internal separation for compact details.

2.$description: Compact separation between closely related controls or content.

3.$description: Comfortable separation within a control group or content cluster.

4.$description: Default separation between sibling interface regions.

6.$description: Section-level separation between distinct content groups.

8.$description: Strong page-level separation between major regions.

page.$description: Canonical separation and inset for major Product Character page regions.

section.$description: Canonical separation between distinct sections within a page.

item.$description: Canonical separation within ordinary control groups and content clusters.

dense.$description: Contextual compact separation for tables, repeated rows, and operational data only.

control.$description: Canonical minimum height for standard interactive controls.

row.$description: Canonical minimum height for ordinary repeated object rows.

rowDense.$description: Minimum height for explicitly dense tables and operational rows; not a global density mode.

ui.$description: Bundled Product Character family for product and plugin chrome.

mono.$description: Bundled technical family for identifiers, code, and tabular operational data.

pageTitle.$description: Canonical page-title size before responsive clamping.

sectionTitle.$description: Canonical section-title size for content hierarchy.

regular.$description: Regular weight for body copy and input values.

medium.$description: Medium weight for restrained emphasis and table headings.

semibold.$description: Semibold weight for controls and hierarchy labels.

bold.$description: Bold weight for high-emphasis labels and signal text.

control.$description: Corner radius for controls and small interactive elements in the Product Character direction.

surface.$description: Corner radius for bounded content surfaces.

overlay.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, popovers, and other elevated overlays.

pill.$description: Fully rounded shape for badges, chips, and pill controls.

instant.$description: No-transition response for reduced motion and immediate state changes.

feedback.$description: Short response for direct control feedback and micro-state changes.

transition.$description: Standard duration for functional spatial and hierarchy transitions.

standard.$description: Default restrained easing for functional interface transitions.

overlay.$description: Restrained depth for dialogs, popovers, and other top-layer overlays.

disabled.$description: Opacity applied to a disabled control while preserving its semantic state.
